mapper.select:
select count(*) total, to_char(occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') name from alarm_info where occur_time > to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and org_id in
#{id}
group by to_char(occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') order by name

select count(*) total, to_char(i.occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as name, i.alarm_level as id from alarm_info i left join asset a on i.asset_id = a.id where i.blank = 1 and i.alarm_level in (1,2,3) and i.occur_time > to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and i.org_id in
#{id}
(a.ASSET_SUPPLIER != 'JCCA' or a.ASSET_SUPPLIER is null)
group by to_char(i.occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), i.alarm_level order by to_char(i.occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

select count(*) total, to_char(occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as name, alarm_level as id from alarm_info a join SYS_ORG o on a.ORG_ID = o.ID where a.blank = 1 and a.alarm_level in (1, 2, 3) and o.TYPE = 2 and occur_time > to_date(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') group by to_char(occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), alarm_level order by to_char(occur_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

select count(1) total from alarm_info i left join sys_org o on i.org_id = o.id where i.status = #{params.status_} and i.org_id in
#{id}

select m.name, tt.desk as id, tt.total from (select t.desk, count(t.desk) total from (select a.desk from alarm_info i left join asset a on i.asset_id = a.id and i.status = 1 and i.alarm_state = 1 and i.blank = 1 and a.ASSET_MODE not like '7%' where a.is_del = 1
(a.ASSET_SUPPLIER != 'JCCA' or a.ASSET_SUPPLIER is null)
group by a.id, a.desk) t group by t.desk) tt left join asset_mode m on tt.desk = m.code
select round(e.TIMEDURATION / 3600, 2) as runTime, a.NAME as assetName, a.IP as assetIp from COLLECT_SYSTEM_TIME e join ASSET a on e.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE a.is_del = 1

select c.ASSET_ID as assetId, c.CPU_USED_RATE cpuUsedRate, c.STATISTICS_YEAR as statisticsYear, c.STATISTICS_MONTH as statisticsMonth, c.STATISTICS_DAY as statisticsDay, c.STATISTICS_HOUR as statisticsHour, a.name as assetName from HOUR_CPU c join asset a on c.asset_id = a.id where c.END_TIME <= to_date(#{params.endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') and c.END_TIME >= to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') order by c.END_TIME asc

select c.ASSET_ID as assetId, c.MEM_USED_RATE memUsedRate, c.STATISTICS_YEAR as statisticsYear, c.STATISTICS_MONTH as statisticsMonth, c.STATISTICS_DAY as statisticsDay, c.STATISTICS_HOUR as statisticsHour, a.name as assetName from HOUR_MEMORY c join asset a on c.asset_id = a.id where c.END_TIME <= to_date(#{params.endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') and c.END_TIME >= to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') order by c.END_TIME asc

select c.ASSET_ID as assetId, c.TEMP_VALUE tempValue, c.STATISTICS_YEAR as statisticsYear, c.STATISTICS_MONTH as statisticsMonth, c.STATISTICS_DAY as statisticsDay, c.STATISTICS_HOUR as statisticsHour, a.name as assetName from HOUR_TEMP c join asset a on c.asset_id = a.id where c.END_TIME <= to_date(#{params.endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') and c.END_TIME >= to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') order by c.END_TIME asc

select c.ASSET_ID as assetId, c.CPU_USED_RATE cpuUsedRate, c.STATISTICS_YEAR as statisticsYear, c.STATISTICS_MONTH as statisticsMonth, c.STATISTICS_DAY as statisticsDay, c.STATISTICS_HOUR as statisticsHour, a.name as assetName from HOUR_CPU c join asset a on c.asset_id = a.id where c.END_TIME <= to_date(#{params.endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') and c.END_TIME >= to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') order by c.END_TIME asc

select c.ASSET_ID as assetId, c.MEM_USED_RATE memUsedRate, c.STATISTICS_YEAR as statisticsYear, c.STATISTICS_MONTH as statisticsMonth, c.STATISTICS_DAY as statisticsDay, c.STATISTICS_HOUR as statisticsHour, a.name as assetName from HOUR_MEMORY c join asset a on c.asset_id = a.id where c.END_TIME <= to_date(#{params.endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') and c.END_TIME >= to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') order by c.END_TIME asc

select c.ASSET_ID as assetId, c.TEMP_VALUE tempValue, c.STATISTICS_YEAR as statisticsYear, c.STATISTICS_MONTH as statisticsMonth, c.STATISTICS_DAY as statisticsDay, c.STATISTICS_HOUR as statisticsHour, a.name as assetName from HOUR_TEMP c join asset a on c.asset_id = a.id where c.END_TIME <= to_date(#{params.endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') and c.END_TIME >= to_date(#{params.startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') order by c.END_TIME asc

select 1 code, o.title orgName, a.name assetName, a.id assetId, o.id orgId, count(i.status) alarmCount from asset a left join (select asset_id, status from alarm_info where status = 1 and alarm_state = 1 and blank = 1) i on i.asset_id = a.id left join sys_org o on a.org_id = o.id where a.is_del = 1 and o.id is not null and a.asset_mode not like '7%'
(a.ASSET_SUPPLIER != 'JCCA' or a.ASSET_SUPPLIER is null)
group by o.title, a.name, a.id, o.id, 1

select 1 code, o.title orgName, a.name assetName, a.id assetId, o.id orgId, count(i.status) alarmCount from asset a left join (select asset_id, status from alarm_info where status = 1 and alarm_state = 1 and blank = 1) i on i.asset_id = a.id left join sys_org o on a.org_id = o.id where a.is_del = 1 and o.id is not null and o.type = 2 and a.asset_mode not like '7%' group by o.title, a.name, a.id, o.id, 1

select min(alarm_level) alarmLevel, orgId, orgName, stationx, stationy from ( select i.alarm_level, o.stationx, o.stationy, o.title orgName, o.id orgId from asset a left join alarm_info i on a.id = i.asset_id left join sys_org o on a.org_id = o.id and o.status = 1 where a.is_del = 1 and o.stationx is not null and o.stationy is not null and o.type = 4 and i.status = 1 and i.alarm_state = 1 and i.blank = 1
(a.ASSET_SUPPLIER != 'JCCA' or a.ASSET_SUPPLIER is null)
group by i.alarm_level, o.stationx, o.stationy, o.title, o.id) group by orgName, stationx, stationy, orgName, orgId
